== Red-link triage on 2007 deck pages (October 2026) ==
Red card links on the 102 deck pages for 2007 Worlds (Day 1, Day 2, Day 3 and Team) were checked against the live wiki. Where needed, they were also checked against the scanned deck sheet on each page.
* 303 links pointed at wrong titles (spelling, punctuation, set suffix, side, or a misread of the sheet). These were relinked to the existing card page. Where the sheet showed a different card than the transcription, the sheet was followed. Examples on Sean McGrath LS: Houjix (V) → Wokling (V) and Saesee Tiin (V) → Sai'torr Kal Fas (V). Example on Bill Kafer DS: Defensive Fire & Houjix → Defensive Fire & Hutt Smooch.
* 49 names that match no card and cannot be read on the sheet were unlinked and left as plain text.
* DS-61-2 (V) on [[2007 Worlds Day 2 Chris Menzel DS Ralltiir Operations]] was relinked to [[DS-61-2]]. The (V) on the sheet is crossed out, and no such virtual card exists in the card data (see that page's Talk).
* [[:File:2007 Worlds Team.pdf]], linked from the 29 Team pages, was uploaded from res.starwarsccg.org (the Wayback copy matches).
The full mapping is logged in the editor's working notes. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 01:54, 21 October 2026 (UTC)

== Missing Day 2 partner sheets (October 2026) ==

Four Day 2 partner sheets are not in [[:File:2007 Worlds Day 2.pdf]] (78 pages). For each player, only the other side's sheet was published, so the deck page for the missing side cannot be written yet.
* [[Phil Johnson]]: Light Side sheet missing. The Dark Side sheet is page 25, [[2007 Worlds Day 2 Phil Johnson DS Carbon Chamber Testing]].
* [[Pat Jurgens]]: Dark Side sheet missing. The Light Side sheet is page 26, [[2007 Worlds Day 2 Pat Jurgens LS We'll Handle This]].
* [[James Booker]]: Light Side sheet missing. The Dark Side sheet is page 33, [[2007 Worlds Day 2 James Booker DS Carbon Chamber Testing]].
* [[Neil Smith]]: Dark Side sheet missing. The Light Side sheet is page 52, [[2007 Worlds Day 2 Neil Smith LS Plead My Case To The Senate]].
If any of these sheets turns up in another scan or a player's own records, it can be added as a deck page and linked from the Day 2 table on [[2007 World Championship]]. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 20:26, 27 October 2026 (UTC)

== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added a Fantasy Worlds subsection from Brad Eier's 9 September 2008 post (ref pcf-23038-334983).
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* In the same post Eier recalled, with "i think", the places Jon Chu 1, Justin Desai 2, Brian Fred 3, Tom Hollingworth 4, Brian Hunter 5, Mike Pistone 37. That would order the 3–4 tie (Fred 3rd, Hollingworth 4th), but it is a recollection, so the Results table is unchanged.
=== Left out ===
* Brian Herold (August 2008, "I believe. I wasn't there.") wrote that four Day 2 byes were available on Thursday and the top 50% of Day 1 advanced. Hearsay, not corroborated; left out.
